title: Man dies in RCMP jail cells
article: A 55-year-old man died on Friday night while in the cells at the local RCMP detachment.

Police said Francis Joseph Mark was arrested following a disturbance involving a cab driver just before 3 a.m. Friday, and was taken into custody. Some time later, during a routine cell check, it was discovered that the prisoner was not breathing, detachment spokesman Sgt. Lee Omilusik said.

Mark was taken to West Coast General by ambulance, where efforts to resuscitate him were unsuccessful. Cause of death has not been determined, and an autopsy was to be performed today. Omilusik said the deceased had no prior criminal history.
The Courtenay Serious Crimes Unit has now been called into investigate the death. Omilusik said this is standard RCMP policy in the case of a death in custody.
